title: Two boiled eggs
summary: Cheap protein; boil a batch for the week.
steps: Lower the eggs gently into a pot of boiling water with a spoon.
Boil for 9 minutes for firm yolks (7 if you like them a little soft).
Move them straight into cold water for 2 minutes, then tap all over and peel under the tap. Unpeeled boiled eggs keep 4 days in the fridge.
